title: Table 3.4a applied to C3.4.6: separation between buildings on the same lot by facing wall height

rows.note: 2.0 m + 2.0 m from Table 3.4a; Figure 3.4l shows 6 m (3 m + 3 m) and Table 4A's 3.5 m would give 7 m (register C4P1-085, C4P1-097)

verified.note: Derived table (twice Table 3.4a). Figure 3.4l (p35) confirms 2m and 3m for the lower bands but shows 6m (3m + 3m) for the upper band against 4m derived from Table 3.4a's 2.0m and 7m from Table 4A's 3.5m.

notes: Addition for Chapter 4 Part 1 (no Chapter 3 equivalent). Twice the Table 3.4a side setback, because C3.4.6 sets buildings back 'as though there is a lot boundary between them'. Keyed on the height of the taller facing wall (proposed fact building.separation_same_lot_wall_height_m). The 3.5-3.6 m and 7.0-7.1 m gaps follow the C3.4.1 rule conditions (above 3.5 m and above 7.0 m).
